def prepare_request_uri_query(oauth_params, uri):
    """Prepare the Request URI Query.
    
    Per `section 3.5.3`_ of the spec.
    
    .. _`section 3.5.3`: https://tools.ietf.org/html/rfc5849#section-3.5.3
    """
    # Parse the URI
    parsed = urlparse(uri)
    
    # Extract existing query parameters
    query_params = extract_params(parsed.query)
    
    # Append OAuth params to existing params
    merged_params = _append_params(oauth_params, query_params)
    
    # Encode the merged parameters
    encoded_query = urlencode(merged_params)
    
    # Reconstruct the URI with the new query string
    return urlunparse((
        parsed.scheme,
        parsed.netloc,
        parsed.path,
        parsed.params,
        encoded_query,
        parsed.fragment
    ))
